notes:
## New features

- None in this release.

## Changes

- Contour-sheet headings now use consistent typography. The footer sits at the bottom with padding, and new sheets omit its divider by default.
- Slim is now the default coordinate-neatline margin. Explicitly saved Standard margins remain available and are preserved.

## Bug fixes

- Matched the footer activity dot to its progress-bar colour, balanced the text separators and spacing, and prevented the idle Ready label from being truncated after activity.
- SmartSmooth now uses the same underlying interpolation as Interpolated Raster before generating contour lines and bands. Simplification and Bézier smoothing remain separate presentation adjustments.
- Restored higher-density interpolated raster rendering at 32×, 64×, 128× and 256×, including updates after panning and zooming. SmartSmooth respects the selected density and joins tile boundaries reliably.
- Corrected compressed sidebar text and undersized AURIS footer logos on Retina displays.
- Changed contour-list item ownership to avoid the wrapper-destruction path implicated in a crash after changing receptor size and opening Contours.
- Removed graphics effects from native macOS popups to avoid the constructor path implicated in an Editor right-click crash.
